card.name: Overdose section wording
card.fires_on: The word overdose or its pieces (Over-dos-age, overex-posure) and the first words after it, in overdosage management sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Inside overdose words
modes.description: Responds on the pieces of overdose, overdosage or overexposure.
modes.example: 10.2 Management of Over<<dos>>age In case of acute overdosage

modes.label: Words leading into overdose
modes.description: Responds on a or an just before overdose, or on the word Treatment opening an overdose passage.
modes.example: In the event of<< an>> overdose, administration should be withheld and general

modes.label: Other drug-term pieces
modes.description: Occasionally fires partway through a protein name in a drug interaction heading.

card.writes: It pushes against drug-related words like drug, drugs and pharmac, with no clear positive theme.
card.plain: It lights up in the overdose section of a drug label, on the word overdose or just before and after it.
